Text: Agent Observability Fundamentals

You cannot improve what you cannot see. Proper observability tracing, metrics, logs, and evaluation is the foundation for debugging, monitoring, and continuously improving production agents.

This is becoming essential for reliable agent operations.

As a dev, I now instrument agents for full observability from day one.

Agent Observability Cheatsheet:
- Trace every step of the agent’s reasoning and tool use
- Collect key metrics (latency, cost, success rate, token usage)
- Log structured data for easy debugging
- Evaluate outputs regularly
- Set up alerts for unusual behavior
Pro tip: Strong observability turns agent failures from mysteries into clear, fixable problems
